title: ISBN-10/13 validation and conversion
requirements: is_valid(s) accepts ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 strings, ignoring hyphens and spaces, and verifies the check digit (ISBN-10 may end in X or x)
to_isbn13(s) converts a valid ISBN-10 to its 978-prefixed ISBN-13 and returns a valid ISBN-13 normalised (digits only)
to_isbn13 raises ValueError for invalid input
user_messages: isbn.is_valid(s) for the library import — both ISBN-10 and ISBN-13, ignore hyphens and spaces, actually check the check digit (ISBN-10 can end in X)
and to_isbn13(s): turn a valid ISBN-10 into the 978 version with the new check digit; if it's already 13 just return it cleaned up; garbage → ValueError
